flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code for this feature. Only work item placeholders for other flows exist: ocmsadminprivateapi workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService (createWorkItemFor* only log '[PLACEHOLDER] ... skipped'). ocmsadminui: a Work Item menu is defined at LinkData.tsx:170-173 but commented out at line 398, there is no pages/WorkItem folder, Dashboard.tsx has no work items; the Tagged Vehicle menu is commented out. There is no hitlist entity
note: Status blank (epic ERP2, 'Logic/flow not received'). There is no hitlist, no work item creation for ownership changes, and no work item dashboard. The only 'work item' in code is a placeholder for DataHive FIN/UEN results (PR/SC, EP/LTVP/WP expired, FIN not found) and those methods only write the log '[PLACEHOLDER] ... feature not ready' (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2920-2924, 3042, 3108, 3123, 3225), so even that does not write to ocms_work_item. grep hit.?list, work.?item, workitem, tagg across the six repos finds nothing else. Because the steps depend on DOS results that do not exist (OCMS33.2), the whole story is not met. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. There is no hitlist, no work item for tagging and no review dashboard; even the DataHive work item placeholder writes no data. Ask URA/the team where this feature is built

steps.step: After ownership details arrive from DOS, OCMS creates work items for vehicles with and without ownership change
steps.detail: DOS results are not received (see OCMS33.2) and no work item is created for ownership changes. createWorkItemForPRSC (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService.java:2920-2924) and its siblings belong to the DataHive FIN/UEN flow and only log '[PLACEHOLDER] Work item creation skipped', with no insert into ocms_work_item. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS decides which vehicles to add to or remove from the hitlist by criteria (offences per ID, suspension type and reason)
steps.detail: There is no hitlist concept in the six repos (grep hit.?list, hit_list, hitlist returns nothing) and no query counts offences per ID for an add/remove decision. The CES list query (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:313-322) only uses PS/FOR suspension and notice age, not offences per ID.

steps.step: Work items show on the Tagging officer dashboard
steps.detail: A Work Item menu is defined (LinkData.tsx:170-173) but menu.push(LinkWorkItem) is commented out (LinkData.tsx:398), there is no pages/WorkItem folder, and Dashboard.tsx shows no work items. The Tagged Vehicle menu is also commented out (LinkData.tsx:406; App.tsx:326-329).

steps.step: The Tagging officer reviews the records of vehicles to add, remove or unchanged
steps.detail: There is no review screen for tagging: the EpicTaggedVehicle import is commented out (App.tsx:43) and the tagged-vehicle route is commented out (App.tsx:326-329); there is no API in ocmsadminapi for tagging records.
